subject: SOC 2 Type II interim attestation request and PO timing implications
messages:
From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@brightwell.health>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@brightwell.health>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II availability + procurement timing for upcoming renewal

Hi Rishi,

We're finalizing our procurement timeline for the Brightwell Health renewal/expansion and I need to confirm a couple of compliance items before we can route the PO. Specifically:

- Do you have the most recent SOC 2 Type II (covering 2026 calendar year) available to share?
- If the report isn't available with a current period that overlaps our renewal window (renewal effective 2027-08-01), can Redwood provide an interim/bridge attestation that will be acceptable to our procurement/legal teams?
- Our PO approval deadline is July 31, 2027. Procurement has indicated they cannot complete the PO without either the current Type II or an approved bridge letter / interim attestation.

We can accept a signed interim attestation that specifically states the audit window covered and any compensating controls in place while the Type II is in progress. If there are standard templates Redwood uses for bridge letters, please share so we can circulate internally.

Thanks — looking to move quickly on this.

Erin
Erin Cole | Sr. Procurement Manager | Brightwell Health
Phone: +1 (206) 555-0182

Attachment: Brightwell-PO-template.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@brightwell.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II availability + procurement timing for upcoming renewal

Hi Erin — thanks for the clear ask and the PO template. Quick summary up front: we can provide a signed interim attestation (bridge letter) that covers the gap through the Type II completion, plus the most recent Type II report we have on hand.

A few items we should align on so the procurement/legal reviewers have what they need:

- Audit window wording: our last completed Type II covers 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31 (report issued 2026-03-10). Our current Type II for 2026 is in progress; expected issue date is mid-August 2027. The bridge would affirm coverage from 2026-01-01 through the date of issuance (and confirm no material scope changes).
- Acceptance criteria: if Brightwell's legal will accept a bridge letter plus the 2025 Type II and a signed statement of no material changes, we can get that signed within 3 business days of agreement on wording.
- PO timing: to align commercial and audit timelines, our recommended route is PO by July 31, 2027 with a contract addendum referencing the forthcoming Type II and attached bridge letter. That gives Brightwell the procurement certainty and Redwood the ability to deliver services without interruption.

I've attached our current public Type II (most recent issued) and a draft bridge letter for your review. Marissa (legal ops) and Neha (compliance) are cc'd to help finalize wording. Proposed next steps:

1) Brightwell to confirm whether the proposed audit-window wording above is acceptable by EOD Thu Jul 1.
2) If accepted, we'll circulate a DocuSign-ready bridge attestation and return signed within 48 hours.
3) Brightwell routes PO (using your template) by July 31 and includes the addendum referencing the attestation.

Let me know if you want to jump on a short call — happy to do a 20-minute sync.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025.pdf, Interim-Attestation-Bridge-July2027.docx
From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@brightwell.health>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@brightwell.health>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II availability + procurement timing for upcoming renewal

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of notes from procurement/legal after an initial review:

- They prefer the bridge letter to explicitly state the audit period covered and confirm that there were no material control exceptions during that period.
- Brightwell's InfoSec has also asked whether a completed CAIQ / SIG baseline (completed within the last 12 months) could be provided in parallel while we await the Type II. Would Redwood be able to share a completed CAIQ or SIG report? That would likely speed our internal security acceptance.
- Regarding signature: Procurement requires a physically signed PDF or an executed DocuSign envelope — an unsigned template won't clear.

Procurement is prepared to move the PO through by July 31 if we receive: (a) the signed interim attestation, (b) the last issued Type II (PDF), and (c) a completed CAIQ (PDF or link). Can you confirm Redwood can deliver all three items by July 22 to allow internal routing?

If yes, we'll schedule our final approval on Jul 28 to meet the PO cutoff. If no, we'll need to escalate to contract exceptions.

Erin

Erin — appreciate the clarity. We can meet the July 22 delivery target for the three items you listed. Concrete commitments below: 

- Signed interim attestation (PDF via DocuSign): we will send the executed envelope by end of day Jul 19. The bridge explicitly states coverage of 2026-01-01 through the date of issuance of the 2026 Type II and confirms no material control exceptions have been reported to date.
- Most recent Type II (PDF): attached (SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025.pdf).
- CAIQ: we'll provide a completed CAIQ export (PDF) and a read-only link to our internal SIG baseline by Jul 19.

Next steps for Brightwell (proposed):
1) Confirm acceptance of the proposed bridge wording (we've included the draft in the DocuSign packet).
2) Route PO by July 31 with clause referencing the forthcoming Type II and the interim attestation. We can add the HubSpot deal id (BW-2319) to the DocuSign packet to simplify procurement tracking.

If procurement/legal need any extra language (e.g., escrow of the final report or additional audit rights), loop Marissa and Neha and we'll work through it quickly.

I'll send the DocuSign envelope and CAIQ link shortly.

Best,
Rishi
